name: sprint-facilitator-kit
description: The room craft for running a sprint week, covering timeboxing, silent work, the people problems, energy across five days, and remote facilitation, part of the Design Sprint Pack by 90n. Use this whenever the user says "run sprint-facilitator-kit", "how do I facilitate this", "someone keeps derailing the room", "the room has gone flat", "how do I run this remotely", "I have never facilitated a sprint", or when a sprint is about to start and the person running it wants the human mechanics rather than the agenda. Use it even for a vague ask like "any tips for keeping the room on track".
